name: Autrance
description: Trance pluck auto phrase generator for NTS-3. ROOT fixes the bass key; each pad touch builds a chord from that root and generates a 16-step bass + chord phrase. Bass uses the root and one octave up; chords play as block voicings or arpeggios. X = Cutoff, Y = Resonance, Depth = mix, DEC = decay, ENV = filter envelope depth. Up to 8 voices polyphonic.
